    <script type="text/javascript">
    $(function () {
        var template = "<div class=\"row p-2 gx-3 gy-0\"><div class=\"col-auto\"><div class=\"input select\"><label class=\"visually-hidden\" for=\"simple-op-0\">Simple Op[]<\/label><select name=\"simple-op[]\" class=\"form-select\" id=\"simple-op-0\"><option value=\"AND\" selected=\"selected\">and<\/option><option value=\"OR\">or<\/option><\/select><\/div><\/div><div class=\"col\"><div class=\"input text\"><label class=\"visually-hidden\" for=\"simple-value-0\">Simple Value[]<\/label><input type=\"text\" name=\"simple-value[]\" class=\"form-control\" id=\"simple-value-0\"><\/div><\/div><div class=\"col-auto\"><div class=\"input select\"><label class=\"visually-hidden\" for=\"simple-field-0\">Simple Field[]<\/label><select name=\"simple-field[]\" class=\"form-select\" id=\"simple-field-0\"><option value=\"keyword\" selected=\"selected\">Free Search<\/option><option value=\"publication\">Publications<\/option><option value=\"collection\">Collections<\/option><option value=\"provenience\">Proveniences<\/option><option value=\"period\">Periods<\/option><option value=\"transliteration\">Transliterations<\/option><option value=\"translation\">Translations<\/option><option value=\"id\">Identification numbers<\/option><\/select><\/div><\/div><div class=\"col-auto\"><button class=\"btn cdli-btn-light search-simple-remove-field\" type=\"button\"><span class=\"fa fa-close\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><\/span><span class=\"visually-hidden\">Remove field<\/span><\/button><\/div><\/div>"
        var autocompleteSources = {
            collection: '/collections/autocomplete?q=',
            provenience: '/proveniences/autocomplete?q=',
            period: '/periods/autocomplete?q='
        }
        var autocompleteFields = ['collection', 'provenience', 'period']
        initializeAutocomplete($(document))

        $('#search-simple-add-field').click(function (e) {
            e.preventDefault()
            var fields = $.parseHTML(template)
            var lastId = $(this).parent().siblings('.row').last().find('input').attr('id').match(/\d+$/)[0]
            var id = parseInt(lastId) + 1

            $(fields).find('input, select').each(function (_, input) {
                $(input).attr('id', $(input).attr('id').replace(/\d+$/, id))
            })
            $(fields).find('label').each(function (_, label) {
                $(label).attr('for', $(label).attr('for').replace(/\d+$/, id))
            })
            $(fields).find('.search-simple-remove-field').click(removeField)

            initializeAutocomplete($(fields))
            $(this).parent().before(fields)
        })

        $('.search-simple-remove-field').click(removeField)

        function removeField (e) {
            e.preventDefault()
            $(this).closest('.row').remove()
        }

        function initializeAutocomplete (context) {
            context.find('input[name="simple-value[]"]').each(function () {
                var input = $(this)
                var row = input.closest('.row')
                var select = row.find('select[name="simple-field[]"]')
                var field = select.val()
                var listId = input.attr('id') + '-suggestions'

                if (!$('#' + listId).length) {
                    input.after($('<datalist></datalist>').attr('id', listId))
                }

                select.on('change', syncAutocompleteState)
                input.on('input', function () {
                    if (autocompleteFields.includes(select.val())) {
                        updateSuggestions(input.val())
                    }
                })

                syncAutocompleteState()

                function syncAutocompleteState () {
                    var datalist = row.find('#' + listId)

                    if (autocompleteFields.includes(select.val())) {
                        input.attr('list', listId)
                        input.attr('autocomplete', 'off')
                        updateSuggestions(input.val())
                    } else {
                        input.removeAttr('list')
                        input.removeAttr('autocomplete')
                        datalist.empty()
                    }
                }

                function updateSuggestions (query) {
                    query = query.toLowerCase()

                    var field = select.val()

                    $.ajax({
                        method: 'GET',
                        dataType: 'json',
                        url: autocompleteSources[field] + encodeURIComponent(query)
                    }).done(function (results) {
                        var datalist = $('#' + listId)
                        datalist.empty()

                        var field = select.val()
                        results.filter(function (result) { return result[field].toLowerCase().includes(query) })
                            .slice(0, 10)
                            .forEach(function (result) {
                                datalist.append($('<option>').attr('value', result[field]))
                            })
                    })
                }
            })
        }
    })
</script>
<script src="/assets/js/smoothScroll.js"></script></body>
</html>
